query_snapshot: For hydrogen peroxide solution from 30 to 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- The evidence inventory includes an archived NIOSH topic page for hydrogen peroxide. [Hydrogen Peroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/topics/hydrogen-peroxide/default.html]
- The evidence inventory includes the NIOSH IDLH page for hydrogen peroxide, which shows NIOSH REL = 1 ppm (1.4 mg/m3) TWA and an original IDLH value of 75 ppm. [Hydrogen peroxide - IDLH | NIOSH | CDC: https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/idlh/772841.html]
- The evidence inventory includes an OSHA chemical data entry for hydrogen peroxide (OSHA PEL listed as 1 ppm 8‑hour TWA). [HYDROGEN PEROXIDE | Occupational Safety and Health Administration: https://www.osha.gov/chemicaldata/630]
- The provided evidence items (NIOSH pages, OSHA entry, chemical summaries, and SDSs present in the inventory) do not contain a visible archived NIOSH table that assigns barrier materials for hydrogen peroxide 30–70% into 8‑hour and 4‑hour groups. [Hydrogen Peroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/topics/hydrogen-peroxide/default.html; Hydrogen peroxide - IDLH | NIOSH | CDC: https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/idlh/772841.html; HYDROGEN PEROXIDE | Occupational Safety and Health Administration: https://www.osha.gov/chemicaldata/630; [PDF] Chemical Summary for Hydrogen Peroxide - SSWM.info: https://sswm.info/sites/default/files/reference_attachments/OAK%20RIDGE%20NATIONAL%20LABORATORY%201995%20Chemical%20Summary%20of%20Hydrogen%20Peroxide.pdf; Hydrogen Peroxide: https://nj.gov/health/eoh/rtkweb/documents/fs/1015.pdf; Hydrogen Peroxide (30%: https://www.fishersci.com/store/msds?partNumber=BP2633500&productDescription=HYDROGEN+PEROXIDE+30%25%2C+500ML&vendorId=VN00033897&countryCode=US&language=en; Hydrogen Peroxide (20 to 40%): https://www.hopenn.com/sds/Hydrogen-Peroxide-20-40%25.pdf]
